title: Cloud Backup and Restore
summary: Back up photos, contacts & files instantly. Secure cloud restore in 1-tap!
description:
Cloud Backup & Phone Restore is your all-in-one solution to back up, protect, and restore your mobile data safely using your own Google Drive storage. Whether you are switching to a new phone, performing a factory reset, or just securing your precious memories, easily save your photos, videos, contacts, SMS, and documents in one tap!

🌟 Key Features
1-Tap Photo & Video Backup: Securely back up high-resolution photos and videos to the cloud and restore them to their original folders.

SMS & Call Logs Recovery: Easily back up text messages and call history. Restore them seamlessly whenever you upgrade or reset your device.

Contacts & Calendar Protection: Keep your address book and schedule safe. Instant recovery with zero data loss.

Documents, Audio & Files: Safely store documents, PDFs, compressed archives, APKs, and audio files.

Apps Manager: Back up installed app details, package names, and Play Store links for easy re-installation.

Automated Scheduled Backups: Set daily, weekly, or monthly automatic background backups so you never forget to protect your files.

Smart Storage Control: Choose Wi-Fi-only backup mode to save mobile data, track real-time progress, and avoid duplicate files with smart conflict management.

🔒 Privacy First & User Control
Your data privacy is our highest priority. All backups are saved directly into your personal Google Drive account.

No Third-Party Servers: We never store, access, or sell your personal files, SMS, contacts, or media.

Transparent Permissions: Permissions (like SMS, Call Logs, or Storage access) are requested ONLY when you use those specific features.

Ad & Analytics Safety: Your personal backup files and communications are never used for ads, marketing, or profiling.

💡 How SMS Restore Works
To restore text messages safely, Android requires the app to temporarily become your default SMS app. The app will guide you through this quick 1-tap setup, and you can switch back to your regular messaging app immediately after the restore is complete. (Note: Supports standard SMS text messages).

Download Cloud Backup & Phone Restore today and keep your digital life safe, secure, and easily recoverable!
